title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-isabella-cole-2026-05-15
content:
Release Train — Weekly Prep notes (weekly sync)
Owners: Isabella Cole (release lead)
Date: 2026-05-15
Target launch: 2026-05-20 (Thu) — final go/no-go meeting 2026-05-19
Attendees (expected): Isabella, Noah, Jordan, Maya, Ethan, QA lead (Priya), SRE oncall (Luca), Security (Anika)

Purpose
- Quick sync on go/no-go checklist, outstanding risks, and owner-level actions for the release train.
- Confirm smoke/canary plan and rollback criteria.
- Surface any blockers that would push the final decision to NO-GO.

Agenda
1) Quick status round (2 min per owner)
2) Go/No-Go checklist walkthrough (10 min)
3) Risks + mitigations (10 min)
4) Action items and owners (5 min)
5) Confirm pre-launch window and final meeting time (1 min)

Current high-level status
- Feature freeze: Complete (branch main cut 2026-05-12)
- Regression test pass rate: 97% passing on main (flaky tests tracked)
- Staging smoke: partial failures during long seq perf test (infra team investigating)
- Security sign-off: in progress (expected 2026-05-17)
- Data migration: dry-run complete; final migration scheduled 2026-05-20 AM
- Canary plan: ready — 10% traffic for 24h, automated rollback on error rate >3x baseline

Go / No-Go checklist (walk through each during meeting)
- Code freeze confirmed: YES (branch cut 2026-05-12)
- All blocking PRs merged: NO — 2 PRs (frontend styling edge case, infra fix) — owners assigned below
- Regression suite: >= 95% pass on main: YES (97%)
- Staging smoke: PASS for core flows, FAIL for long-sequence perf (perf regression) — infra investigating (priority)
- Performance targets (median latency < 120ms): TARGET unclear in long-seq; need one more perf run on staging (see action)
- Monitoring & alerts configured: YES (dashboards, runbooks linked)
- SLO/SLAs reviewed with customer-success: YES
- Security review: PENDING (expected 5/17)
- Backup + DB migration plan reviewed: YES (dry-run done)
- Rollback tested: PARTIAL — rollback procedure validated for app version, not for schema change (schema change is backward-compatible but we need final runbook)
- Compliance/enterprise checklist: YES for baseline, outstanding enterprise docs requested by ACME Corp (Jordan owns)

Open risks / blockers (ranked)
1) Perf regression in long-seq request path (HIGH) — observed 20% p95 tail increase on staging when sequence >4096 tokens. Impact: canary user-facing latency spikes. Owner: Ethan. Mitigation: infra is testing kernel selection tweak; fallback to smaller model variant if not resolved.
2) Two blocking PRs not merged (MED) — frontend PR (styling causing layout shift on IE11 internal app) owner: Maya; infra PR (container runtime memory leak fix) owner: Noah. Both need signoff by 5/16 EOD.
3) Security review pending (MED) — security notes about token retention in logs. Owner: Jordan + Anika. Expected signoff 5/17. If delayed, we may keep feature flag gated for enterprise customers.
4) Schema rollback coverage incomplete (LOW-MED) — DB migration backwards-compatible but no validated rollback procedure for a partial rollback. Owner: Luca (SRE). Action: create rollback runbook by 5/18.

Smoke & Canary plan (summary)
- Smoke tests (automated) to run on staging: core auth flows, inference path, billing checkout, embedding store.
- Canary: 10% traffic for 24 hours; canary metrics to monitor: 5xx rate, p95 latency, token cost/routing errors, customer-facing error rate.
- Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute or >3x baseline, p95 latency > target by 50%, significant increase in token cost (>30% QoE drop), or large customer complaint spike.
- Post-canary decisions: if stable for 24h with no alerts, increase to 50% and monitor another 12h; then full rollout.

Action items (owner — due)
- Ethan: complete kernel selection perf test on staging + produce perf run results for long-seq (p50/p95/p99) — due 2026-05-16 EOD.
- Noah: prioritize and merge infra memory-leak PR; coordinate canary infra deploy 5/19 AM — due 2026-05-16 EOD.
- Maya: finish frontend PR and add IE11 mitigation (temporary) + QA signoff — due 2026-05-16 EOD.
- Jordan: chase security sign-off and respond to retention questions; produce minimal SOC notes for ACME — due 2026-05-17 EOD.
- Luca (SRE): write schema rollback runbook and validate rollback on staging dry-run — due 2026-05-18.
- Priya (QA): rerun full regression + flaky test triage list and mark tests to quarantine — due 2026-05-16 midday.
- Isabella (me): finalize go/no-go decision doc and circulate 5/18 AM; schedule final go/no-go meeting 5/19 10:00am PT — due 2026-05-18 AM.

Notes to self / unresolved questions
- If security signoff slips past 5/17, do we proceed with feature flag for enterprise customers only? Need guidance from product (Jordan to confirm).
- Can we add an automated perf smoke (short-run) to pre-launch window to catch long-seq regressions right before canary? Ask release-engineering to add 30-min perf probe on 5/19 06:00am.
- Confirm on-call rotation for post-launch 72h watch (Luca to confirm SRE pager schedule).

Quick links
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Release+20.3+Launch+Runbook
- Canary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/rel/canary-20-3
- JIRA board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REL

Next steps before the weekly sync
- Owners above to update status in this doc (quick comments) by EOD 2026-05-16.
- I will compile a one-page go/no-go checklist and circulate to execs 5/18 AM.

Draft minutes template for the weekly meeting
- Attendees:
- Summary decisions (GO/NO-GO at the end):
- Top 3 risks and mitigation owners:
- Action items (owner + due):

End.
